## How it works

::: {.rules}
```r
icebreaker::charades
```

::: {.printed}
```r
function(team, actor, words) {
  timer <- countdown(minutes = 3)             # 3 minutes per round
  score <- 0
  for (word in words) {                       # pick a word
    act(actor, word)                          # act the word; no talking!
    if (talked(actor) || cheated(team)) next  # disqualified: skip the word
    while (word != readline("guess")) {}      # guess until you're right
    if (!expired(timer)) score <- score + 1   # guessed in time: a point
  }
  return(score)
}
<environment: namespace:icebreaker>
```
:::
:::

<!-- reveal the function step by step: each step is a comment and its code.
     steps[i] is the fragment step for line i+1 of the printed code (null = always shown) -->
<script>
{
  const steps = [null, 0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 1, 5, null, null];
  document.querySelectorAll('.rules .printed code > span').forEach((line, i) => {
    if (steps[i] == null) return;
    line.classList.add('fragment');
    line.dataset.fragmentIndex = steps[i];
  });
}
</script>

::: {.card}
